title: Croissant ML metadata generator + spec validator
context: Catalog entries should emit machine-readable Croissant ML metadata so downstream ML/data tooling can consume them. This task builds a generator that maps the canonical metadata model to pinned Croissant ML v1.0 and validates output against the spec. It ships with golden fixtures built only from synthetic/public metadata. No partner is yet secured, so verifiedNeed is false and requestor is TO BE SECURED.
objective: Deliver a Croissant ML metadata generator + spec validator (pinned v1.0) with committed golden fixtures exercised in CI, as a PR.
acceptanceCriteria: Emits and validates against the pinned Croissant ML v1.0 context/SHACL (version recorded in specVersions).
Ships committed golden fixtures (synthetic/public metadata only): valid metadata that must pass and malformed cases that must fail, exercised in CI.
Code MIT-licensed; pnpm build && pnpm test && pnpm lint green; DCO signed-off.
output: src/croissant/ (generator + validator) with tests under src/croissant/__fixtures__/
